name: Gea de Albarracín (Spain)
description: A yellow and white hoist stripe bearing the crowned arms of Gea de Albarracín (a castle on white), the fly two thirds red.
history: Municipal flag of Gea de Albarracín; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Gea de Albarracín arms — castle on white
